intro_summary: 本章把同一問題下的回答比較與理由保存為偏好資料，再轉為可計算的訓練訊號。DPO與PPO是可選的兩條學習路線，先後章節安排用於學習，並不表示成品一定要依序套用兩種訓練；共同的資料與能力取捨需分別檢查。

sources.title: Exact arithmetic and relative-preference reasoning
sources.details: Two pairs of chopsticks contain 2*2=4 items; 2+2=4. Ordered operands 0..7 give 8*8=64 questions; unordered pairs with repetition give 8*9/2=36 families. Relative reward ordering alone does not impose an absolute adequacy threshold, as Eq.1 is invariant to adding the same constant to both rewards.
